1. (Currently Amended) A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a __specially modified__ carboxylated inulin; and allowing the cement composition to set.  
2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures __ranging from room temperature to__ about 280 *F.  
3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about __consistent__ for a period of time after the cement composition is placed.  
4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a suspension aid is optionally added to the cement composition.  
5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition.  
6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of __500 or greater__.  
7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises __at least one of__ carboxymethylated inulin __or chemically modified inulin__.  
8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.  
9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt.% of carboxylated inulin __with defined purity standards__.  
10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition further comprises __at least one of__ borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof.  
11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a __targeted__ subterranean formation.  
12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a __defined__ wellbore.  
13. (Currently Amended) A method of cementing in a subterranean formation comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a __specially modified__ carboxylated inulin; placing the cement composition in the subterranean formation; and allowing the cement composition to set __under confined conditions__.  
14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures __ranging from room temperature to__ about 280 *F.  
15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about __consistent__ for a period of time after the cement composition is placed.  
16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein a suspension aid is optionally added to the cement composition.  
17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition.  
18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of __500 or greater__.  
19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises __at least one of__ carboxymethylated inulin __or chemically modified inulin__.  
20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.  
21. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt.% of carboxylated inulin __with defined purity standards__.  
22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition further comprises __at least one of__ borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof.
